english: Each decision is a row the game core wrote the moment it was taken (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); the names in `…` are the codes of playerbot_explain_rules.h and the overlay's constants. An equipment change: the pass puts on a piece whose score (TERM_TOTAL) beats the worn one's by SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE per mille, and a piece it took off within the hour only by SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT percent. A weapon's score is its blow x1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, the model of GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: the attack grade on foot, the weapon's roll, the plus's attack, a monster's defence at the bot's level, average and skill damage, mt2009's hidden bonus by the weapon's level) with Iwakura's tier on the blow alone, and beside it the class's preference and the fixed lines; the rest of the gear's is defence, lines and stones times the family's tier. A counter line: the price's steps in the order the pricing takes them - Iwakura's sheet at the yang rate and the inflation, the lines, the sale memory, the market ledger, the step limit, the keeper's spread, the floors, the rounding. The flags are the core's, the anomalies the panel's.
polski: Każda decyzja to wiersz zapisany przez rdzeń gry w chwili jej podjęcia (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); nazwy w `…` to kody z playerbot_explain_rules.h i stałe nakładki. Zmiana ekwipunku: przegląd zakłada rzecz, której wynik (TERM_TOTAL) przewyższa noszoną o SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE promili, a rzecz zdjętą w ciągu godziny dopiero o SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT procent. Wynik broni to jej cios ×1000 (TERM_BLOW_X1000, model GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt: stopień ataku na piechotę, rzut broni, atak z plusa, obrona potwora na poziomie bota, średnie obrażenia i obrażenia umiejętności, ukryty bonus poziomu broni mt2009) ze stopniem Iwakury tylko na ciosie, i obok preferencja klasy i stałe bonusy; reszty ekwipunku — obrona, bonusy i kamienie razy stopień rodziny. Linia lady: kroki ceny w kolejności wyceny — arkusz Iwakury ze stawką yang i inflacją, bonusy, pamięć sprzedaży, rejestr rynku, ogranicznik kroku, rozrzut sprzedawcy, progi, zaokrąglenie. Flagi zapisał rdzeń, anomalie wyliczył panel.
translation: Her karar, oyun çekirdeğinin karar anında yazdığı bir satırdır (log.playerbot_equip, log.playerbot_listing); `…` içindeki adlar playerbot_explain_rules.h kodları ve katmanın sabitleridir. Ekipman değişikliği: tarama, puanı (TERM_TOTAL) giyilenden SWAP_MARGIN_PERMILLE binde fazla olan parçayı kuşanır; son bir saatte çıkardığı parçayı ise ancak SWAP_BACK_MARGIN_PERCENT yüzde fazlaysa. Bir silahın puanı darbesi x1000'dir (TERM_BLOW_X1000, GetPlayerBotWeaponHitDamageAt modeli: yayan saldırı derecesi, silahın zarı, artıdan gelen saldırı, botun seviyesindeki bir canavarın savunması, ortalama ve beceri hasarı, mt2009'un silah seviyesine bağlı gizli bonusu), Iwakura kademesi yalnızca darbeye uygulanır, yanında sınıf tercihi ve sabit satırlar; ekipmanın geri kalanı: savunma, satırlar ve taşlar çarpı ailenin kademesi. Tezgâh satırı: fiyat adımları fiyatlama sırasıyla - yang oranı ve enflasyonla Iwakura'nın listesi, satırlar, satış hafızası, pazar defteri, adım sınırı, satıcı marjı, tabanlar, yuvarlama. Sayı, oyunun son birkaç dakikada kaydettiği karakterlerdir; yeni giren biri biraz gecikmeyle görünür, yeni çıkan biri ise kısa süre sayılmaya devam eder.

polski: Ile potworów stoi w każdym miejscu respu: ×1 = jak w grze, ×2 = dwa razy więcej, aż do ×4. Nie trzeba restartu, a po restarcie ustawienie zostaje; dodatkowe potwory dochodzą przy najbliższym respie danego miejsca (Metiny i bossowie po swoim czasie odradzania, zwykle 15–25 minut). Off: nobody gets it; the bots lose the unopened chests of the chain and new bots are made without one. Players' chests are never touched. A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_STARTER_CHEST in .env).
polski: Łańcuch Skrzyń Ucznia (od Skrzyni Ucznia I po Skrzynię Arcymistrza: mikstury, eliksiry, zielone kamienie i następna skrzynia) — jeden przełącznik dla graczy i botów. Wyłączona: nie dostaje jej nikt; boty tracą nieotwarte skrzynie z łańcucha, a nowe boty rodzą się bez niej. Skrzyń graczy nic nie rusza. english: This field shows the saved setting. 100% = standard strength without an extra bonus; 115% = 15% more attack before defence. english: The official rule (the default): every point from 17 to 19 is another roll for Master - at 17 one chance in four, at 18 in three, at 19 in two - and the 20th point is a sure M1, so a skill costs 17 to 20 points and never gets stuck. The old rule (since 2.2.14): one roll at the 17th point (25%, 45% below level 35, +25% for every reset at the Old Woman); a failed one leaves the skill at 17 at every level, and only a Book of Oblivion, the Skill Reset Scroll or the Old Woman (up to level 30) move it on. Under both, the scroll makes the next 17th point a sure Master. Bots and the Companion play the same rule. Changes are live without a restart and survive the next start until you change this option in the launcher (Difficulty, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).
polski: Oficjalna zasada (domyślnie): każdy punkt od 17 do 19 to kolejny rzut na Mistrza - przy 17 jedna szansa na cztery, przy 18 na trzy, przy 19 na dwie - a 20. punkt daje M1 na pewno, więc umiejętność kosztuje od 17 do 20 punktów i nigdy nie utyka. Stara zasada (od 2.2.14): jeden rzut przy 17. punkcie (25%, 45% poniżej 35 poziomu, +25% za każdy reset u Starszej Pani); po porażce umiejętność stoi na 17 na każdym poziomie, a dalej prowadzi tylko Księga Zapomnienia, Zwój Powrotu Umiejętności albo Starsza Pani (do 30 poziomu). W obu zasadach zwój daje pewnego Mistrza przy następnym 17. punkcie. Boty i Towarzysz grają tą samą zasadą. Zmiana działa na żywo bez restartu i zostaje po ponownym starcie, dopóki nie zmienisz tej opcji w launcherze (Poziom trudności, M2_SKILL_STUCK_17).
translation: Resmi kural (varsayılan): 17 ile 19 arasındaki her puan Usta için yeni bir zardır - 17'de dörtte bir, 18'de üçte bir, 19'da ikide bir şans - ve 20. puan kesin M1 verir; böylece bir beceri 17 ile 20 puan arasında tutar ve asla takılı kalmaz. english: The game takes part of the drop chance from a character above its monster: two levels over 98% of the chance is left, five over 92%, ten over half (a boss and a Metin stone 30%), fifteen and more over 1%. This setting is the least share of the chance a kill keeps whatever the level difference: 0% = the game's own penalty (the default), 100% = no penalty, anything between a floor (at 25% a character fifteen levels over drops at a quarter of the chance). It never lowers a chance, so a character under its monster or at its level drops as before, and the drop rate and the drop bonuses act on the result as they always did. It covers the whole drop of a kill - items, drop groups, Metin stones, bosses and books - for players and bots alike; yang and experience stay as they are. The client Wiki's note on the level penalty describes the game without this setting. A change applies from the next kill, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT in .env).
polski: Gra zabiera część szansy na drop postaci wyższej od potwora: 2 poziomy wyżej zostaje 98% szansy, 5 wyżej 92%, 10 wyżej połowa (boss i Metin 30%), 15 i więcej wyżej 1%. To ustawienie to najmniejsza część szansy, jaką zabicie zachowuje bez względu na różnicę poziomów: 0% = kara jak w grze (domyślnie), 100% = bez kary, pomiędzy = podłoga (przy 25% postać 15 poziomów wyżej dropi z jedną czwartą szansy). Nigdy nie obniża szansy, więc postać niższa od potwora albo na jego poziomie dropi jak dotąd, a stawka dropu i bonusy do dropu działają na wynik jak zawsze. Dotyczy całego dropu z zabicia — przedmiotów, grup dropu, Metinów, bossów i ksiąg — u graczy i botów tak samo; yang i doświadczenie bez zmian. Notatka o karze za poziom w Wiki klienta opisuje grę bez tego ustawienia. Zmiana działa od następnego zabicia, bez restartu, i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DROP_LEVEL_FLOOR_PCT w .env).
translation: Oyun, canavarından yüksek seviyedeki bir karakterin drop şansının bir kısmını alır: iki seviye yukarıda şansın %98'i kalır, beş yukarıda %92'si, on yukarıda yarısı (boss ve Metin taşında %30), on beş ve daha fazla yukarıda %1'i. Bu ayar, seviye farkı ne olursa olsun bir öldürmenin koruduğu en küçük şans payıdır: %0 = oyunun kendi cezası (varsayılan), %100 = ceza yok, arası bir taban (%25'te on beş seviye yukarıdaki bir karakter şansın dörtte biriyle drop alır). Hiçbir şansı düşürmez; canavarından düşük ya da aynı seviyedeki bir karakter eskisi gibi drop alır, drop oranı ve drop bonusları sonuca her zamanki gibi etki eder. Bir öldürmenin tüm dropunu kapsar - eşyalar, drop grupları, Metin taşları, bosslar ve kitaplar - oyuncular ve botlar için aynı; yang ve deneyim değişmez. İstemci Wiki'sindeki seviye cezası notu bu ayar olmadan oyunu anlatır. english: How fast the players' characters and the bots move, the Companion with them: a percent of the game's own speed, 100% = as in the game. It goes on top of everything the game gives - gear, skills, potions, a sprint, a horse or a mount - on foot and in the saddle; the client takes at most 255 (2.55 times a character with nothing on, 100), so a fast character reaches that ceiling sooner. The bots move at the same pace as the players, and the Companion keeps up with its player; monsters move as in the game. The character window shows the speed with this percent (at 50% a character of 120 reads 60). A change applies at once to everyone in the game, without a restart, and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_MOVE_SPEED_PCT in .env).
polski: Jak szybko poruszają się postacie graczy i boty, a z nimi Towarzysz: procent szybkości z gry, 100% = jak w grze. Dochodzi do wszystkiego, co daje gra — ekwipunku, umiejętności, mikstur, sprintu, konia i wierzchowca — pieszo i w siodle; klient przyjmuje najwyżej 255 (2,55 raza tyle co postać bez niczego, 100), więc szybka postać dojdzie do tego pułapu wcześniej. Boty chodzą w tym samym tempie co gracze, a Towarzysz nadąża za swoim graczem; potwory poruszają się jak w grze. Okno postaci pokazuje szybkość z tym procentem (przy 50% postać ze 120 ma 60). Zmiana działa od razu u wszystkich w grze, bez restartu, i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_MOVE_SPEED_PCT w .env).
translation: Oyuncu karakterlerinin ve botların ne kadar hızlı hareket ettiği, Yoldaş da onlarla birlikte: oyundaki hızın yüzdesi, %100 = oyundaki gibi. Oyunun verdiği her şeyin üstüne eklenir - ekipman, beceriler, iksirler, koşu, at ya da binek - yaya ve eyerde; istemci en fazla 255 kabul eder (hiçbir şeyi olmayan bir karakterin 100'ünün 2,55 katı), bu yüzden hızlı bir karakter bu sınıra daha erken ulaşır. Botlar oyuncularla aynı tempoda hareket eder ve Yoldaş oyuncusuna yetişir; canavarlar oyundaki gibi hareket eder. Karakter penceresi hızı bu yüzdeyle gösterir (%50'de 120 olan bir karakter 60 gösterir). Değişiklik oyundaki herkes için hemen, yeniden başlatmadan geçerli olur ve sen launcher'da (ZORLUK SEVİYESİ düğmesi, .env içinde M2_MOVE_SPEED_PCT) değiştirene kadar yeniden başlatmadan sonra da kalır.

english: How many bots of each village (the first and the second of every kingdom) do nothing but Metin stones: they walk their village, break its stones, pick up their drop and put it on their stand - the skill books and the soul stones always on the stand, the rest by the usual rules. Channel 1 and channel 2 hand the role out apart, so 5 a village is 30 bots on CH1 and 30 on CH2; the droppers of CH2 serve their stands on CH1, as the other sellers of CH2 do. In M2 they fight the Bestials in their reach too. 0 switches the role off. A change applies at once, without a restart.

english: How many Cor Draconis a day the Power of the Dragon Eye gives at the Alchemist (10 = as in the game; one fewer on the day of the first hand-in) and the extra drops of Metin stones and bosses for players, as a percent of kills (0 = off): Dragon Stones (1-5 shards from a Metin by its level, a Cor Draconis from a boss, two from the strongest; from level 30 and only with the Alchemy on) and Kupon SM (10 to 500 Dragon Coins by the Metin's level, a value or two more from a boss, up to 5000 from the strongest of level 105; the smaller ones more often, so a kill is worth as many coins on average as before). Nothing for a character more than 15 levels over the victim and nothing for the bots; a Companion's kill counts for its owner. The bots get the same Cor Draconis a day as the players. A change is live at once and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP and M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP in .env).
polski: Ile Cor Draconis dziennie daje Moc Smoczego Oka u Alchemika (10 = jak w grze; w dniu pierwszego oddania o jeden mniej) i dodatkowy drop z Metinów i bossów dla graczy, w procentach zabić (0 = wyłączony): Smocze Kamienie (1-5 odłamków z Metina zależnie od jego poziomu, Cor Draconis z bossa, dwa z najsilniejszych; od 30 poziomu i tylko przy włączonej Alchemii) i kupony SM (od 10 do 500 Smoczych Monet zależnie od poziomu Metina, z bossa o jeden lub dwa nominały więcej, aż do 5000 z najsilniejszego od 105 poziomu; mniejsze częściej, więc średnio zabicie daje tyle monet co dawniej). Nic dla postaci silniejszej od przeciwnika o więcej niż 15 poziomów i nic dla botów; zabicie Towarzysza liczy się jego właścicielowi. Boty dostają tyle samo Cor Draconis dziennie co gracze. Zmiana działa od razu i zostaje po restarcie, dopóki nie zmienisz jej w launcherze (przycisk POZIOM TRUDNOŚCI, M2_DS_EYES_PER_DAY, M2_EXTRA_DS_DROP i M2_EXTRA_COUPON_DROP w .env).

Rakibinden 15 seviyeden fazla yüksek bir karakter ve botlar hiçbir şey almaz; bir Yoldaşın öldürmesi sahibine sayılır. Botlar günde oyuncularla aynı sayıda Cor Draconis alır. english: The Alchemist in every kingdom's first village: from level 30 a letter to him, shards from monsters, Cor Draconis and the Alchemy window (the button in the inventory and the O key). On: it works for players and bots. Off: nobody gets the letter, a shard or a Cor Draconis, the Alchemist has none of his options, the bots take no part, and a player's client hides the Alchemy button in the inventory and opens no window on O; the stones and boxes a character holds stay its own. A change is live at once - a player's client in the game learns of it within a few seconds, and the Alchemist's letter and arrow go with the button - and stays across a restart until it is changed in the launcher (the DIFFICULTY button, M2_DRAGON_SOUL in .env).

english: How many game channels the server runs. With two, some of the bots play on CH2, so the server spreads them over two CPU cores and carries more bots at once. Every shop, bots' and players', stands on CH1: a bot on CH2 that wants to open or serve its shop or to buy something moves to CH1, and a free bot of CH1 moves to CH2 in its place. The share set here is the least CH2 carries; with nobody waiting to move, CH2 may take up to ten points more. With three and four, CH3 (and CH4) carry fresh bots from level one besides: characters of their own, 500 a kingdom, made at the first start with this setting. They never move to CH1 or CH2, and the bots of CH1 and CH2 never come to theirs; there are no shops, bot guilds, wars, tower or events on CH3 and CH4. One channel by default.
polski: Ile kanałów gry uruchamia serwer. Przy dwóch część botów gra na CH2, więc serwer rozkłada je na dwa rdzenie procesora i udźwignie więcej botów naraz. Wszystkie sklepy (botów i graczy) stoją tylko na CH1: bot z CH2, który chce otworzyć albo obsłużyć swój sklep albo coś kupić, przechodzi na CH1, a wolny bot z CH1 przechodzi na jego miejsce na CH2. Ustawiony udział to najmniej tyle botów na CH2; gdy nikt nie czeka na przejście, CH2 może przejąć do 10 punktów więcej. Przy trzech i czterech na CH3 (i CH4) grają do tego świeże boty od 1 poziomu: osobne postacie, po 500 na królestwo, tworzone przy pierwszym starcie z tym ustawieniem. Nie przechodzą na CH1 i CH2, a boty z CH1 i CH2 nie przychodzą do nich; na CH3 i CH4 nie ma sklepów, gildii botów, wojen, Wieży ani wydarzeń. Domyślnie jeden kanał.
translation: Sunucunun kaç oyun kanalı çalıştırdığı. İki kanalda botların bir kısmı CH2'de oynar; böylece sunucu onları iki işlemci çekirdeğine dağıtır ve aynı anda daha fazla bot taşır. Botların ve oyuncuların bütün dükkânları yalnızca CH1'dedir: dükkânını açmak, ona bakmak ya da bir şey satın almak isteyen CH2'deki bir bot CH1'e geçer, CH1'deki boşta bir bot da onun yerine CH2'ye geçer. Burada ayarlanan pay, CH2'nin taşıdığı en az miktardır; geçiş bekleyen kimse yoksa CH2 on puana kadar fazlasını alabilir. Üç ve dört kanalda CH3'te (ve CH4'te) ayrıca 1. seviyeden başlayan yeni botlar oynar: her krallık için 500 ayrı karakter, bu ayarla yapılan ilk başlatmada oluşturulur. Hiçbir zaman CH1'e veya CH2'ye geçmezler, CH1 ve CH2'nin botları da onlara gelmez; CH3 ve CH4'te dükkân, bot loncası, savaş, kule ve etkinlik yoktur. Varsayılan: tek kanal.
